Spectral libraries

  • Home
  • Products
  • Spectral Libraries

Achieve better data and report with confidence

The quality of the data you acquire is vital to your research. Delivering results that are regulatory compliant and meet customer standards is, therefore, paramount to your success.

Discover high resolution libraries and enhance the quality of your analysis
The high resolution MS/MS spectral libraries and nominal mass QTRAP versions are the fastest way to analyze large batches of MS/MS data for accurate compound detection and identification. The verified libraries contain the spectra of key compounds for the testing of forensic drugs. In addition, you will find a pesticide library for food and environmental analysis. Followed by mycotoxin and antibiotic libraries for food testing libraries. For environmental testing facilities, an acquired spectral library of common flurochemicals has been compiled. There is also an all in one library available to deliver accuracy for the screening of unknown samples.

With a comprehensive library, you can easily create methods and process targeted and non-targeted screening data on your complex samples faster and easier.

Currently SCIEX OS and LibraryView software can be used to import spectral libraries and provide library screening capabilities. The acceptable library importing formats include: .lbp, .clq, .tplp, .lvs, .mdb and .sdf.  

Learn more about SCIEX OS software >>
Learn more about LibraryView software >>

Open Access DIMSpec PFAS LibraryThe Open Access DIMSpec PFAS library is a publicly available spectral library converted directly from the Database Infrastructure for Mass Spectrometry (DIMSpec) PFAS project. It includes 132 PFAS compounds and is distributed with appropriate open access licensing and citation information via NIST, enabling transparent reuse and reliable reference for PFAS analysis. The license for use and reuse of this data is provided here as well. If you would like to know more about this community, please visit https://github.com/usnistgov/dimspec

Citation: Ragland, Jared , Place, Benjamin (2023), Database Infrastructure for Mass Spectrometry - Per- and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances, National Institute of Standards and Technology, https://doi.org/10.18434/mds2-2905 (Version: 1.1, Accessed 2026-02-24)		13205/2026
